ground_truth: Authorization bypass in portal/sign/lib/show-signature.php: user-controlled pid, user, type or signer keys can request another person's signature without an ownership/authUserID check.
SQL injection in the Immunization controller's indexAction/reportAction: this change removes ApplicationTable::quoteValue() around user-controlled patient_id ($pid_val) before building SQL.

Cross-patient FHIR CareTeam access in FhirCareTeamService.php: this change removes its patient-scoped getOne override and does not implement IPatientCompartmentResourceService, so the base service does not apply patient-context filtering.
Open redirect in the Eye Exam form: an unvalidated request url is passed directly to header('Location: ...') in place of the prior redirect helper.
Unauthenticated arbitrary file read and write in EtherFaxActions::disposeDocument(): request file_path reaches sendFile/readfile and file_put_contents without path validation or authenticate().

Authorization bypass in portal/sign/lib/save-signature.php: client-controlled is_portal is decoupled from signature type, allowing a portal user to create an admin/provider signature with an arbitrary user.
Unauthenticated token disclosure in the MedEx callback: under ignoreAuth=true, an unvalidated callback_key enters the callback branch and the login response, including token data, is echoed.

SQL injection in SearchConfigClauseBuilder::buildSortOrderClauseFromConfig(): the Patient REST API _sort field reaches search->getField() and is concatenated as an ORDER BY identifier without an allowlist.
Payment gateway secret exposure in portal/portal_payment.php: gateway_api_key, which can be a private Stripe API key, is rendered into client-side JavaScript for every portal user.
Session timeout bypass in library/auth.inc.php: moving skip_timeout_reset to the outer timeout condition lets a request-controlled value skip session-expiration validation.
SQL injection in the Prescription controller: a request-influenced ORDER BY identifier is concatenated into SQL after mysql_real_escape_string/add_escape_custom, which does not make identifiers safe.
Authenticated blind SQL injection in new_search_popup.php: request-controlled fldname is used as a SQL column identifier without validation.
OS command injection in backup.php: request-influenced listid/layoutid are interpolated into a shell command built for mysqldump --where, permitting shell metacharacters and command execution.
Server-side request forgery in eye_mag/report.php: stored fields are emitted without escaping into HTML or CSS url() in a report that a server-side PDF renderer processes and fetches URLs from.
Stored cross-site scripting in portal/portal_payment.php: unescaped table_args and checksum values are echoed into a JavaScript script block.
XInclude injection in CCDA import: enabling LIBXML_XINCLUDE when parsing XML permits included references to read arbitrary server files.

Missing authorization in get_claim_file.php: the endpoint serves a request-selected claim file through fpassthru after a CSRF check but without a billing ACL check, so a user without the relevant permission can download protected health information.
SQL injection in portal/add_edit_event_user.php: unescaped request values, including event ID, are concatenated into SQL statements.

Authentication bypass in portal/account/register.php: an unauthenticated visit to the registration page unconditionally sets patient_portal_onsite_two, pid and authUser portal session values. Other portal endpoints grant access based on those session values, so registration creates an authenticated portal session without a login.
SQL injection in interface/reports/immunization_report.php: form_code values are concatenated into a SQL IN clause without parameterization; date parameters are also unescaped.
Insecure direct object reference in pnotes_print.php: request noteid is used to fetch a note without checking that it belongs to the current patient or authorized user.
Local file inclusion/path traversal in interface/forms/LBF/new.php: request formname reaches include_once without path validation.
Stored cross-site scripting in C_Document::retrieve_action(): disable_exit can be set through positional URL mapping, returning raw document bytes that Controller::act echoes as text/html.
Stored DOM cross-site scripting in patient demographics Additional Address: stored fullAddress[0] is assigned to innerHTML without HTML escaping.
